races.paceDynamic: Mumayaz looks the lone natural pace-setter in this field, with most others holding up or sitting prominent at best. The lack of genuine speed will create a moderate tempo early before accelerating in the final two furlongs. With seven of ten runners adopting hold-up tactics, this sets up perfectly for horses that can quicken from off the pace. The tactical verdict clearly favours hold-up horses who can produce a late turn of foot.

scenarios.label: A
scenarios.title: Hold-Up Brigade Dominates
scenarios.trigger: If Mumayaz sets uncontested fractions and the pace is moderate throughout
scenarios.body: The lack of early speed allows closers to get into perfect striking positions and the race becomes a sprint finish where class tells. Hold-up horses with proven acceleration benefit from the tactical setup.

scenarios.label: B
scenarios.title: Front Pair Control
scenarios.trigger: If Mumayaz and Jersey Maverick work together early and maintain control
scenarios.body: The two prominent runners dictate terms and kick clear before the hold-up brigade can respond effectively. Early positioning proves crucial over the short six-furlong trip.

scenarios.label: C
scenarios.title: Sustained Finish
scenarios.trigger: If the pace quickens significantly from the three-furlong pole
scenarios.body: The race becomes a true test of stamina over the sprint distance and horses that can maintain their effort longest prosper. Those with recent winning form handle the pressure best.

scenarios.label: D
scenarios.title: Traffic Nightmare
scenarios.trigger: If the large hold-up contingent gets bunched up in the straight
scenarios.body: Several hold-up horses find trouble in running while those with early position cruise past the struggling field. Clear running becomes the decisive factor.

watchPoints.text: Mumayaz could steal this if allowed to dictate easy fractions with no other natural pace-setters engaged
Traffic issues likely in the straight with seven hold-up horses needing room simultaneously
Jersey Maverick's headgear change could spark improvement stepping back to shorter distance
Under The Twilight faces tactical challenge with inexperienced jockey from wide draw
Koffee And Kale's soft ground form suggests strong claims if getting clear run from hold-up position

races.paceDynamic: Jack Andrea will likely lead from the off with Naughty Niall tracking close behind, creating the early pace in this small field. With seven of nine runners being hold-up horses, the early gallop should be steady rather than frenetic, allowing the leaders to dictate terms. The combination of soft ground and 1m4f distance means stamina will tell late, but the lack of early pace pressure gives prominent runners a significant tactical edge. This race shape strongly favours front-runners and prominent racers who can avoid the inevitable late traffic problems.

scenarios.label: A
scenarios.title: Front Running Dominance
scenarios.trigger: If Jack Andrea and Naughty Niall get an easy lead without early pressure
scenarios.body: The pace-setters control the race from the front and kick clear when the hold-up horses are still organising behind them. The soft ground saps the finishing kick from the back-markers who face a wall of horses to get through.

scenarios.label: B
scenarios.title: Hold-Up Horse Traffic Jam
scenarios.trigger: If the seven hold-up horses bunch together turning for home
scenarios.body: Multiple horses come with late runs simultaneously but can't all get clear racing room in the straight. The best of them squeezes through but several unlucky runners get blocked and never get their chance to shine.

scenarios.label: C
scenarios.title: Pace Collapse Finish
scenarios.trigger: If Jack Andrea and Naughty Niall go too slow early and get swamped late
scenarios.body: The early leaders crawl along and get overwhelmed by a wall of hold-up horses who all get into contention together. The strongest stayer among the closers prevails in a bunched finish where pace doesn't matter.

scenarios.label: D
scenarios.title: Tactical Speed Battle
scenarios.trigger: If Naughty Niall or another prominent runner challenges Jack Andrea early
scenarios.body: The early pace quickens as two or three horses dispute the lead, setting up the race for a strong closer. The pace duel compromises the early leaders and opens the door for the best hold-up horse to strike.

watchPoints.text: Jack Andrea could get an uncontested lead with so many hold-up horses behind him creating a tactical nightmare

Naughty Niall's stamina for 1m4f is questionable despite his prominent running style suiting the race shape
The Bay Warrior has the class edge but De Sousa must find racing room among the crowded field of closers
Soft ground conditions will emphasise stamina over speed in the final two furlongs favouring proven stayers

races.paceDynamic: With all eight runners showing hold-up tendencies and no confirmed front runner, this race will develop into a crawling pace where the field drifts along in a pack through the early stages. The absence of natural pace-setters means whoever goes forward early - likely Quick Turn or Talking In Kode - will set modest fractions that keep the entire field in contention turning for home. This tactical setup heavily favours horses with the best turn of foot and finishing kick, as the slow pace will compress the field and create a cavalry charge finish where pure acceleration trumps stamina. Hold-up horses with proven sprint finishes will dominate this race shape.

scenarios.label: A
scenarios.title: Crawling Pace Sprint
scenarios.trigger: If the early pace is genuinely slow with no horse willing to commit
scenarios.body: The field remains bunched turning for home, creating a frantic dash where the best finishers thrive in the soft conditions. Horses like Vega's Virtue and That's Enough, who have shown sharp turns of foot recently, will benefit most from this compressed sprint finish.

scenarios.label: B
scenarios.title: Moderate Pace Grind
scenarios.trigger: If one horse takes the initiative early and sets more honest fractions
scenarios.body: The race develops into a truer test where stamina becomes more important than pure speed. This plays to the strengths of consistent performers who can sustain their effort rather than rely on a devastating kick.

scenarios.label: C
scenarios.title: Tactical Stalemate
scenarios.trigger: If multiple horses attempt to lead but none commits fully
scenarios.body: The race becomes a stop-start affair with multiple pace changes that disadvantage those needing a steady rhythm. Only the most adaptable and tactically aware horses can cope with this type of messy development.

scenarios.label: D
scenarios.title: Early Breakaway Works
scenarios.trigger: If one horse makes an early move and the field allows a significant gap to develop
scenarios.body: The leader gets an easy time in front and proves hard to catch despite the soft ground favouring closers. This unlikely scenario would suit any horse brave enough to make the running and sustain it.

races.paceDynamic: Oasis Sunrise will take this field along from the front with minimal early pressure, as most rivals prefer to sit off the pace. Sansanetti and Everyoneknowsadave may track in prominent positions but are unlikely to challenge the leader early. The large contingent of hold-up horses including Law Supreme, Jack Sparowe, Blue Wonder, Bearwith, Lesrico, Goldie Trickett and Happy Chandler will create a significant kick from the back in the final three furlongs. This race shape strongly favours front-runners and prominent racers who can avoid the inevitable traffic problems that will engulf the hold-up brigade.

scenarios.label: A
scenarios.title: Front Runner Dominates
scenarios.trigger: If Oasis Sunrise gets an easy lead and kicks clear turning for home
scenarios.body: The uncontested leader will have too much in hand when the hold-up horses make their late surge. Harry Vigors can dictate terms and save enough for the finish on ground that suits.

scenarios.label: B
scenarios.title: Hold-Up Horse Strikes
scenarios.trigger: If the pace becomes moderate and allows closers to get into contention early
scenarios.body: Blue Wonder or Law Supreme can time their challenge perfectly as the field bunches turning in. The soft ground will suit their staying power over this trip.

scenarios.label: C
scenarios.title: Pace Collapses Late
scenarios.trigger: If Oasis Sunrise goes too fast early and multiple horses converge in the final furlong
scenarios.body: The race will become a sprint finish where Happy Chandler's recent good form and low weight can pay dividends. Sansanetti could also benefit from the strong pace collapse.

scenarios.label: D
scenarios.title: Prominent Tracker Prevails
scenarios.trigger: If Everyoneknowsadave or Sansanetti can stalk the leader and pounce late
scenarios.body: A horse sitting just behind Oasis Sunrise avoids the traffic but gets first run on the leader. This tactical position proves decisive in a messy finish.
